fields.statement: When a fan-out call has not already returned through its mock short-circuit — for a query operation, a MockResults dictionary holding an entry for the query name; for BatchAllAsync, any MockResults dictionary the caller has obtained, even an empty one — and has not already thrown on an already-requested cancellation, then if ShardsValues.Shards is supplied but contains no entries, the call reaches no shard and returns its empty or default result immediately.
fields.scope: ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSet's ReadAll, ReadFirst, RunAsync, BatchAllAsync and Write fan-out operations when given a non-null, empty ShardsValues selection, downstream of each operation's own mock short-circuit (which tests the MockResults backing field, so the check never itself creates the lazily-created dictionary) and upfront cancellation check.
